added.name: Vorflux
added.long_description:
Vorflux is a cloud-based AI coding agent for teams that takes work from an idea, ticket, or message through planning, implementation, review, testing, and a pull request.

Its harness coordinates parallel agents, uses different models for planning and adversarial review, and retains codebase knowledge across sessions. Each team's repository and full stack run on dedicated compute, where QA agents test the application in a real browser and record video evidence.

Vorflux connects to tools such as GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Slack, Figma, and Jira, as well as cloud infrastructure and observability tools. Teams can bring their own models, with tasks routed to the best-value model. Vorflux also helps teams set up the harness and work through their first backlog.
added.one_liner: A cloud-based AI coding agent for teams

added.name: Ordo Labs
added.long_description:
Ordo Labs is bringing AI into regulated labs. In paid pilots with labs in the US and Europe, Ordo cut post-analysis work by 90%+.

CROs and CDMOs are a $314.8B industry, but they can't rely on generic AI tools, because every result must be traceable, every system validated, and every change QA-approved. Ordo is the AI-native OS for regulated labs: each lab gets its own deployment built to be validated, every output links back to its source data, and scientists and QA sign off on every result. Every workflow on Ordo inherits these controls.

Live today: data analysis, quality review and reporting. We're advised by laboratory executives and have interviewed 100+ scientists. Our goal is to make regulated labs AI-native, so science can move at the speed of AI.

Run a CRO or CDMO? Email us at founders@ordolabs.ai.
added.one_liner: The AI-native OS for regulated labs

long_description.before:
Expo lets developers write apps that are written in JavaScript and run natively on Android, iOS, and the web. Our cloud services that work with all Expo and React Native apps, named Expo Application Services (EAS), further speeds up teams by helping them get to the app stores as fast as possible and continue growing.

We believe that mobile apps provide a better experience than websites, but making apps is much more difficult than it needs to be. With Expo, we're bringing together the best of the web, like its development speed, fast iteration cycles, easy deploys, and automatic cross-platform support, and the performance, device capabilities, and user experience of native apps.
long_description.after:
Expo is agentic mobile infrastructure. Developers and AI agents use Expo to create, build, test, validate, ship, and update apps for Android, iOS, and the web from one codebase. 

The open-source Expo framework gets an app started, and Expo Services handles the rest in the cloud: Expo Build and Expo Submit for app stores, Expo Update for over-the-air updates, Expo Workflows for CI/CD, Expo Simulators for remote iOS Simulators and Android Emulators, and Expo Observe for production performance. Indie developers and some of the world’s largest companies use Expo to ship faster.

one_liner.before: Expo brings together the best of web and native app development
one_liner.after: The fastest way to build and run apps

long_description.before:
Whalesync makes data syncing easy. Our automation platform syncs data between key business tools like Webflow/Wix/WordPress and Airtable/Notion/Google Sheets. We give marketing teams two-way, real-time sync, so they can manage their website from their favorite collaboration tools.

Whalesync launched during Y Combinator’s S21 cohort. Since then we’ve raised from some of the world’s top investors. We’re now trusted by hundreds of companies like [Ramp](https://ramp.com/), [Webflow](https://webflow.com/), and [Alchemy](https://www.alchemy.com/), and process millions of transactions every day. Many of our customers enjoy the product so much they [tell all their friends](https://whalesync.com/customers).
long_description.after:
Whalesync is a two-way data sync tool for business teams. It keeps records consistent between CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, and Pipedrive, databases such as Postgres and Supabase, workspaces such as Airtable, Google Sheets, and Notion, and websites built on Webflow, WordPress, or Wix. When a record is created, edited, or deleted in one app, Whalesync makes the same change in the other, so each team can work in the tool it prefers without copying data by hand.

Its Live Export feature keeps a read-only copy of data from apps like Shopify, QuickBooks, Stripe, and HubSpot in Google Sheets, Airtable, Notion, or Supabase for reporting and AI. Syncs are set up in minutes without code, or by an AI assistant through Whalesync's MCP server, and keep running without maintenance.

Its customer stories include Webflow, Descript, and Material Security. Every plan starts with a free trial.

Whalesync launched in Y Combinator's Summer 2021 batch.

one_liner.before: Manage your website from your favorite tools like Airtable and Notion
one_liner.after: Two-way sync for your CRM, spreadsheets, database, and website

long_description.before: We turn natural Language into Multi-Drone Mission execution. Degla is built around a simple idea: once you’ve expressed your intent, the system owns the problem.You don’t babysit drones. You don’t micromanage failures. You don’t rewrite plans. You state the goal, Degla figures out how.
long_description.after:
Degla AI builds autonomy software that enables drones to understand spoken instructions, reason onboard, and adapt as the mission unfolds. Once you’ve expressed your intent, the system owns the problem.

An operator can say, “Find the missing hiker wearing a red sweater.” The drone plans the mission, interprets what it sees, and adjusts its flight as new information emerges. The operator sets the objective and the aircraft handles the execution.

At the core is an onboard vision-language model that interprets what the drone sees, understands the operator’s intent, and guides mission planning, execution, and adaptation. Running locally on NVIDIA Jetson, it makes mission decisions without relying on cloud inference.

one_liner.after: Reason is most world's effective agent on cost per task

long_description.before: Lyon builds private foundation models for banks, insurance companies, and fintechs. Each model learns from the company’s proprietary transactions, payments, clicks, and customer interactions to predict credit, fraud, collections, income, churn, and lifetime value; and runs inside the company’s cloud, so its data and intelligence remain under its control. Lyon is already working with a major insurer and trained a model on 28B transactions for a fintech serving tens of millions of active users, identifying premium-card converters 4x more precisely than its existing rules; the model is now being deployed for credit.
long_description.after:
Lyon builds private foundation models for banks, fintechs, funds, brokers and payments companies, turning their own data into better predictions.

These models apply the transformer technology behind large language models to transaction histories, loan records and customer activity. They learn relationships across events and over time that manually engineered features can miss, producing richer signals for existing models and new applications.

The same model can support fraud detection, credit default prediction, loss given default estimation and product recommendations. Lyon develops and deploys each institution’s model, with software to keep it current and integrate its predictions into existing systems.

At a consumer fintech with tens of millions of users, a Lyon model trained on tens of billions of transactions delivered a 112% relative improvement in default prediction PR-AUC over the fintech’s existing tree-based model.

one_liner.before: Foundation models on enterprise transaction data.
one_liner.after: Foundation models on enterprise event data.

long_description.before:
Tarifflo is the infrastructure layer for modern customs - AI-powered filing, tariff recovery, and customs intelligence on one platform.

Filing should be free. Legacy ABI software charges you per entry, per user, per module. Brokers charge for every transaction. Tarifflo's filing software costs nothing - file directly with CBP under companies own filer codes.

We make money when our clients do. 1 in 8 entries has an error that overpays duty - misclassification, tariff stacking, valuation, origin. Most importers never catch them. Our AI audits your entries, finds the overpayments, and helps file for your refund. 

Under both is the same engine, live tariff intelligence covering every HTS code, Chapter 99 program, exclusion, and rate change - so the duty you pay going forward is as right as the refunds we recover looking back.
long_description.after:
Tarifflo is the modern ABI, built for the AI agent era.

Legacy ABI software was built for people keying entries into screens. Tarifflo is built for code and agents. Every part of customs work is an API call: create entries from documents, classify every line to HTS, fill PGA records, apply Chapter 99 duties, transmit to CBP and track status through liquidation.

Your agents can file customs. Connect Claude or any MCP client and it prepares full entries using the same API. You review and approve, and Tarifflo files under your own filer code. Developers get REST and webhooks. Everyone gets one key, one meter and one bill.

Under it all is the same engine: live tariff intelligence covering every HTS code, Chapter 99 program, exclusion and rate change. The duty you file going forward is as right as the duty we audit looking back. 1 in 8 products we audit is overpaying, and if you overpaid on past entries we find it and file for your refund.

one_liner.before: The first AI government affairs firm.
one_liner.after: The First AI Government Affairs Firm.
